description: When Severna Park High School students Lauren Carlson, Parker Cross, Sabina Khan, Megan Moulsdale and Katrina Schultz united in spring 2019 to make a statement about the need for mental health awareness in their community, they had no way of predicting the momentum their advocacy would gain.
title: Our Minds Matter Gains Momentum in Anne Arundel County - Delegate Heather Bagnall — Heather Bagnall - Maryland State Delegate - District 33
